verdict.rationale: Khoj is built around natural-language interaction. You can chat with it and its connected sources, search notes in natural language, and talk to it by voice. Natural-language queries also trigger online research, Python code execution, and scheduled email automations, and slash commands are available across clients such as WhatsApp. Community users confirm the chat and search functions work, though early chat relied on OpenAI. Missing for 10: evidence that setup and configuration (data sources, agents, admin settings) can be done through natural language rather than the admin panel or UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of agentic features like automations and code execution.
